verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents that individual users can log in with a personal claude.ai account instead of managing an API key, which covers the sign-in half of the story. However, the documented personal-account path is tied to paid Claude Pro or Max subscriptions, and nothing in the evidence shows any free-tier access. Missing for 10: evidence of a free tier or no-cost usage via personal sign-in, and documentation of the usage limits that apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Claude Pro or Max subscription: log in with your Claude.ai account.
